settings.wewrite_folder_desc: Central folder for all WeWrite content. Subdirectories (dump, cache, themes) are created automatically.
settings.svg_threshold_desc: Each inline SVG larger than this threshold (in KB) will be converted to PNG. Smaller SVGs stay as vector. WeChat hard article limit is 1MB.
settings.clear_fingerprint_desc: Resets all image and SVG fingerprint records. Use if the wrong cover or content images appear after publish.
settings.clear_note_configs_desc: Clears all per-note render and publish settings (cover, style, account, thumb media IDs). Each note will start fresh on next render.
settings.reset_wewrite_desc: Deletes all fingerprint records, note configs, cached material images, generated/cropped/converted images under cache, and debug logs. Returns the plugin to a clean state.

settings.default_size_desc: Size used when generating without specifying one (e.g. 1024x1024, 1024*1024, or 2K)
settings.test_ai_text_desc: Verify the API key and base URL are valid
settings.test_ai_image_desc: Verify the API key and endpoint are valid
settings.debug_log_publish_desc: Save publish parameters, content, and API results to structured debug notes
settings.debug_log_render_desc: Write structured render diagnostics to debug notes on every render
settings.debug_show_copy_desc: Show copy HTML content button on WeWrite news view toolbar
settings.debug_log_ai_desc: Write structured AI call logs for every AI request (Image Gen, digest, etc). Includes model, prompt, response. Image generation only logs saved local file path, not image content.
settings.sync_enable_desc: Sync your vault across devices via WebDAV. Disabled by default — no sync operations occur until enabled.
settings.sync_webdav_url_desc: Full URL to your WebDAV server (e.g. https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/)
settings.sync_password_desc: WebDAV account password. Stored in system keychain.
settings.sync_remote_dir_desc: Directory on the WebDAV server for this vault. All synced files are placed under this path. Other devices must use the same directory name to sync together.
settings.sync_interval_desc: How often to sync automatically. Sync also runs on startup.
settings.sync_test_connection_desc: Verify WebDAV server is reachable and credentials are valid
settings.sync_log_debug_desc: Write structured sync debug logs to the debug folder for troubleshooting
settings.sync_max_file_size_desc: Files larger than this are skipped during sync. Default 50 MB.
settings.sync_conflict_desc: Cannot enable WeWrite sync because the following sync solutions are already active:
settings.sync_conflict_action: Please disable them before enabling WeWrite sync.
settings.sync_warn_data_risk: Experimental feature that may still have issues: sync can cause data conflicts or loss. Back up your data and accept the risk — do not keep critical data here as the sole copy.
settings.sync_warn_webdav_only: Standard WebDAV servers only; optimized for JianguoYun (free & paid plans). Other servers (Nextcloud, etc.) are not fully verified.
settings.sync_warn_jgy_free: JianguoYun free-plan limits: ~600 requests per 30 min, 750 items max per directory listing, limited storage & monthly traffic. For many files or frequent edits, consider the paid plan.
settings.sync_warn_auto_resume: When the traffic quota runs out, sync pauses automatically (notes .md are synced first) and resumes by itself after the quota resets — no manual action needed.
settings.sync_warn_plugin_conflict: Do not enable alongside other sync plugins (Obsidian Sync, Remotely Save, etc.) — they may conflict and corrupt data.
settings.sync_warn_multidevice: Avoid editing the same file on multiple devices at the same time — this causes sync conflicts.
settings.sync_server_info_low_space: Remote storage below 100 MB — free up space to avoid sync failures.
settings.sync_risk_confirm: I understand, I accept the risk
settings.sync_reset_desc: Clear all sync state and start fresh. Local files are untouched. On next sync, local files upload as new and remote-only files are pulled down.
settings.sync_reset_confirm_desc: This will clear the following and cannot be undone:
settings.sync_reset_warn: After reset, files that exist only on the remote server will be downloaded to your vault on the next sync.
settings.export_settings_desc: Download all settings as a JSON file. API keys are exported in plain text — keep this file secure.
settings.import_settings_desc: Load settings from a JSON file. Supports v1.x and v2.x formats. Invalid accounts are skipped automatically.

paste.desc_heading: Copy a heading node from your browser / 135 editor / WeChat article and paste it below. Text, numbering and colors are detected automatically; shape values can be parameterized via the param switches.
paste.desc_quote: Copy a quote node (blockquote / section / p) from your browser / 135 editor / WeChat article and paste it below. Text, colors and shape values are detected automatically; params can be toggled.
paste.desc_callout: Copy a callout node (section / div) from a WeChat article or clipping and paste it below. Padding, margins, radius, borders, background and title/body text are parameterized automatically; the detected type fills the other 12 variants.
paste.desc_table: Copy a table node (table / wrapping section) from your browser / 135 editor / WeChat article and paste it below. Header, body and zebra stripes are detected; params can be toggled.
paste.desc_divider: Copy a divider node (hr / section) from your browser / 135 editor / WeChat article and paste it below. Colors and spacing are detected automatically; params can be toggled.
paste.desc_list_task: Copy a task list node (ul/ol with checkboxes or ✅/⬜ icons) from your browser / 135 editor / WeChat article and paste it below. Check icons, size, spacing and colors are detected as params.
paste.desc_list: Copy a list node (ul / ol / wrapping section) from your browser / 135 editor / WeChat article and paste it below. Colors and spacing are detected automatically; params can be toggled.

deco_lib.heading.none_desc: A plain heading with no decoration.
deco_lib.heading.plaque_desc: A versatile plaque for composing your own border/background/gradient line, replacing 9 decorators such as underline and border styles.
deco_lib.heading.curtain_desc: A color band hangs from the top border; the background block follows left/center/right alignment（例 5）
deco_lib.heading.pill_desc: A blue capsule-shaped background block whose width fits its content（例 4）
deco_lib.heading.lightBg_desc: A horizontal gradient background block with white text（例 22 变体）
deco_lib.heading.centerBlock_desc: An orange-yellow centered color block, with the number and body text separated by ｜（例 16/17）
deco_lib.heading.gradientBlock_desc: A gradient lintel block with two-value border radius and a colored shadow（例 6/8）
deco_lib.heading.roundGradient_desc: A gradient block with an irregular shape: three rounded corners and one pointed corner（例 18）
deco_lib.heading.underlineBlock_desc: A color block heading with a matching underline（例 14）
deco_lib.heading.shadowBlock_desc: A color block with a hard shadow and a number, following left/center/right alignment（例 11）
deco_lib.heading.leafPair_desc: Two colored leaf shapes; the number can sit on the first leaf（例 1）
deco_lib.heading.pillTriangle_desc: A color block heading with a triangle accent below and a matching underline（例 2）
deco_lib.heading.cornerNails_desc: A bordered box with corner dots and mark lines above and below（例 10）
deco_lib.heading.ghostNumber_desc: A large translucent number overlaid above the heading, following left/center/right alignment（例 9）
deco_lib.heading.bgImage_desc: A background image layered behind the heading, following left/center/right alignment（例 15）
deco_lib.blockquote.none_desc: A plain blockquote that keeps only the default line-height spacing.
deco_lib.blockquote.classicBar_desc: A light-background card with a left border: change the background/edge/radius/italic/shadow to cover most WeChat Official Account quote styles.
deco_lib.blockquote.doubleEdge_desc: A card with borders on both sides; the two sides can differ in color (e.g. dark green solid line + light green hairline).
deco_lib.blockquote.cornerNails_desc: A thin-bordered box with dots in the four corners; the dots match the border color, and the open space above and below gives a letter-paper feel.
deco_lib.blockquote.bigQuote_desc: A large quotation mark in the top-left corner, with a light background and a left border — ideal for full-paragraph quotes.
deco_lib.blockquote.glassCard_desc: A translucent glass card with a soft colored shadow and an accent left bar for a clear, airy feel.
deco_lib.blockquote.nestedFrame_desc: A double nested border; outer-thin/inner-thick or outer-thick/inner-thin both work.
deco_lib.blockquote.starBorder_desc: Star/dot patterns run along the border; the pattern, line width, color, and radius are all variables.
deco_lib.blockquote.gradientEdge_desc: A gradient left bar with a light gradient background and a soft colored shadow — striking yet tasteful.
deco_lib.blockquote.darkCard_desc: A dark gradient card with light text, suited to closing with a key quote or epigraph.
deco_lib.divider.none_desc: The default thin-line divider; color and spacing follow the theme's divider settings.
deco_lib.divider.aurora_desc: A blue-purple-pink five-stage gradient that fades at both ends, like flowing neon（例 1）
deco_lib.divider.aquaSky_desc: A blue-cyan two-color gradient, rich in the center and fading at both ends（例 2）
deco_lib.divider.hairline_desc: A minimalist thin solid line, beige by default; recolor it to reproduce gray, white, light brown, and other hairlines（例 3/5/12/13）
deco_lib.divider.cyanEdge_desc: A thick cyan top edge line, like a lightly brushed brow（例 4）
deco_lib.divider.goldEdge_desc: A thick gold top edge line, like a gilded title brow; works well as a major section divider（例 8）
deco_lib.divider.inkGroove_desc: A recessed engraved line like a faint mark on an inkstone — understated and enduring（例 6）
deco_lib.divider.skyBand_desc: A blue band across the center that fades out, nearly transparent at both ends（例 7）
deco_lib.divider.twinLineText_desc: Two thin lines flanking a line of text; can serve as a byline, slogan, or follow prompt（例 9）
deco_lib.divider.twinLineIcon_desc: Two thin lines flanking a logo image, suited to separating sections with an account logo（例 11）
deco_lib.divider.dotPattern_desc: Rose and light-blue small squares in alternating order, forming a patterned motif（例 10 方点）
deco_lib.divider.dashedLine_desc: A thin dashed line — airy and light, suited to a breezy writing style.
deco_lib.inline.none_desc: No decoration; keeps the browser and theme default styles.
deco_lib.inline.danqing_desc: Single-color text, like brush-painted accents; default teal #009688（粗体例 1）
deco_lib.inline.moyan_desc: Ink-black text, steady and reserved; default near-black #1a1a1a（粗体例 6）
deco_lib.inline.liucai_desc: Gradient text flowing from indigo to magenta（粗体例 5）
deco_lib.inline.sujian_desc: Rice-paper background with ochre-red text, like writing on plain paper（行内代码例 1）
deco_lib.inline.qingquan_desc: Light cyan background with dark green text, like a clear spring over stones（行内代码例 2/11）
deco_lib.inline.zhupi_desc: Light gray background with vermilion text, like a scholar's cinnabar annotations（行内代码例 3/8）
deco_lib.inline.xingjian_desc: Warm apricot background with orange-red text, like apricot paper in the sun（行内代码例 6/7）
deco_lib.inline.hupo_desc: Amber background with gold-orange text, a matching outline, and a faint shadow（行内代码例 9/10）
deco_lib.inline.dianqing_desc: Light indigo background with indigo text and a pale cyan outline（行内代码例 12）
deco_lib.inline.dailan_desc: Snow-gray background with dark blue text and a thin border（行内代码例 13）
deco_lib.callout.none_desc: Renders exactly as in Obsidian, with only the default line-height spacing injected.
deco_lib.callout.paperTint_desc: A light paper feel with semantic pastel tints; the defaults fully reproduce the WeChat clip example (Warning/Tip gradient, Note/Info/Success solid light backgrounds).
deco_lib.callout.sunsetGold_desc: A warm sunset-glow card — “molten gold at sunset, twilight clouds joined like jade”; an amber-to-rose gradient with warm brown body text.
deco_lib.callout.rainMountain_desc: A fresh green mountain-stream scheme evoking “new rain over an empty mountain”; light, low-saturation card with a left bar.
deco_lib.callout.starGlow_desc: A dark night-sky card with neon semantic colors and glowing shadows; light body text (inspired by Tokyo Night / Dracula).
deco_lib.callout.skyPorcelain_desc: A blue-cyan scheme like Ru kiln sky-after-rain glaze, with a misty glaze gradient; card with a left bar.
deco_lib.callout.accentGlow_desc: All callout types uniformly follow the theme accent color: an accent left bar with an accentBg2 gradient light background (migrates the old blocks.callout.style=gradient).
deco_lib.mermaid.inkCeladon_desc: Ink-wash celadon scheme: white background, dark blue outlines, jade nodes — clean and neat.
deco_lib.mermaid.starVoyage_desc: Dark night-sky scheme: ink-blue background with neon outlines and links, ideal for dark-themed articles.
deco_lib.mermaid.plainBrush_desc: Plain-paper ink-line scheme: white background, black lines, gray text — a minimalist fine-brush style.
deco_lib.mermaid.sunsetWarm_desc: Warm sunset scheme: warm paper background, amber outlines, orange-red links.
deco_lib.mermaid.celadonGlaze_desc: Celadon glaze scheme: misty blue background, celadon nodes, lake-blue links.
deco_lib.image.lightShadow_desc: A centered rounded card with a soft shadow — the most common style on WeChat Official Accounts; the caption is centered gray text.
deco_lib.image.inkFrame_desc: A “picture-frame” feel with a 3px ink outline, rounded corners, and a gray shadow.
deco_lib.image.captionPaper_desc: A “caption on paper” style: light paper outline with left-aligned gray caption text.
deco_lib.image.subtleGlow_desc: Inline, bottom-aligned with a 4px radius and an extremely light shadow, suited to in-article illustrations.
deco_lib.image.silhouetteGlow_desc: 6px radius, light shadow, centered — a clean frameless illustration.
deco_lib.math.flowFormula_desc: Default: body color, standard font size, centered, no card.
deco_lib.math.paperFormula_desc: Light card: pale gray background with rounded corners, padding, and a light shadow.
deco_lib.math.rulerFormula_desc: Left bar: an accent vertical line with an extremely light background, left-aligned.
deco_lib.math.nightFormula_desc: Dark card: ink-blue background with light-colored formulas, ideal for dark-themed articles.
deco_lib.math.accentFormula_desc: Accent formula: accent-colored text on an extremely light accent background.
deco_lib.excalidraw.softFrame_desc: White background with a 1px light border, padding, rounded corners, and a light shadow.
deco_lib.excalidraw.inkBoard_desc: A “drawing board” feel with a 3px ink border, rounded corners, and a gray shadow.
deco_lib.excalidraw.nightBoard_desc: Dark card: ink-blue background with padding and rounded corners.
deco_lib.excalidraw.cloudShadow_desc: No border, soft shadow, large radius.
deco_lib.table.none_desc: A plain table that keeps only the basic borders and padding.
deco_lib.table.clean_desc: A clean card with a light gray header: rounded corners, thin borders, and a soft shadow — suited to simple tables in body text.
deco_lib.table.teal_desc: Teal header with matching borders, a spot-teal first column, and light gray zebra stripes — crisp and airy.
deco_lib.table.navy_desc: Navy header with light indigo zebra stripes and a bolded first column — formal yet not dull.
deco_lib.table.paper_desc: An apricot paper-letter feel: warm header, dark underline, thin horizontal separators, rounded card.
deco_lib.table.dark_desc: Ink-black gilded header row with light zebra stripes in the body — high contrast that stays readable.
deco_lib.table.gradient_desc: An emerald gradient header with matching light green zebra stripes — bright and lively.
deco_lib.table.green_desc: Pine-green header, thin-bordered rounded card — calm and readable, suited to academic settings.
deco_lib.table.sky_desc: Sky-blue header with ink zebra stripes, rounded corners, and a light shadow — techy and layered.
deco_lib.table.orange_desc: Warm orange header with cream-orange zebra stripes — friendly and warm, suited to operations and lifestyle articles.
deco_lib.table.gray_desc: Classic light gray header, full borders, light gray zebra stripes — steady and versatile.
deco_lib.list.ordered.none_desc: A minimal default ordered list (numbers with regular spacing).
deco_lib.list.ordered.classicOrder_desc: Consolidates the original ordered-list settings: number/indent/item spacing, with a default look identical to the legacy version.
deco_lib.list.ordered.plainOrder_desc: Native numeric numbers with keyword coloring — the most common ordered list on WeChat Official Accounts（有序例 1）
deco_lib.list.ordered.badgeOrder_desc: Black badges with white numbers, plus a title and description paragraph — structured steps（有序例 2）
deco_lib.list.ordered.circleOrder_desc: Circular number badges — round and eye-catching, suited to key-point steps.
deco_lib.list.unordered.none_desc: A minimal default unordered list (dots with regular spacing).
deco_lib.list.unordered.classicList_desc: Consolidates the original unordered-list settings: bullet/spacing/indent/item spacing, with a default look identical to the legacy version.
deco_lib.list.unordered.plainBullet_desc: Native dots with generous line spacing（无序例 1）
deco_lib.list.unordered.jadeCard_desc: Light green cards underneath with compact dots, suited to fresh/nature content（无序例 2）
deco_lib.list.unordered.dotBullet_desc: Dot beads arranged item by item, suited to proofreading and checklists（无序例 3）
deco_lib.list.unordered.blueEdge_desc: A card with a blue left bar and dots, suited to product/method lists（无序例 5）
deco_lib.list.unordered.iconList_desc: Icons with single-line text, common for hot lists and news flashes on WeChat Official Accounts（图标例，图标可选 24+ 种）
deco_lib.list.unordered.dashBullet_desc: Short dash bullets — airy and light; keeps the dash symbol implementation.
deco_lib.list.unordered.hairlineGap_desc: Items separated by hairlines — orderly and clear, suited to terms and key-point lists.
